source.source_locator: 消防法 第13条の2第6項

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 他都道府県発行免状の所持者の違反を認めた知事は、免状を交付した知事へ通知する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 違反地の知事には他県発行免状に関する通知義務がない。
evidence.reasoning_path: violation jurisdiction differs from issuing jurisdiction -> notify issuing governor

collision.note: Batch 2 source-defined jurisdiction branch distinct from C012.

independent_review.rationale: Article 13-2(6) directly supports notification to the issuing governor when another prefecture detects a violation; distinct jurisdiction branch.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 23 accepted candidates cover distinct statutory roles, duties, authorities, temporal boundaries, eligibility routes, enforcement triggers, or emergency obligations. C016 adds insufficient incremental practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
